translation.title: Getting to Seongsu & Seoul Forest
translation.summary: A simple orientation guide for choosing between Seongsu Station and Seoul Forest Station when visiting the neighborhood.
translation.body_markdown:
# Getting to Seongsu & Seoul Forest

Two useful rail access points serve different sides of the neighborhood.

## Seongsu Station

**Seongsu Station** is on Seoul Subway Line 2.

Use it when your first stops are mainly around:

- Seongsu shopping streets
- Yeonmujang-gil
- cafes and retail spaces closer to the central Seongsu blocks

## Seoul Forest Station

**Seoul Forest Station** is on the Suin-Bundang Line.

Use it when you want to begin around:

- Seoul Forest
- the western side of the Seongsu area
- a slower park-to-neighborhood walking route

## You do not have to return to the same station

A useful approach is to enter through one station and leave through the other.

For example:

1. arrive near Seoul Forest
2. walk through the park and nearby streets
3. continue toward central Seongsu
4. leave from Seongsu Station

The reverse direction works as well.

## Plan around your first and last stop

Choose your arrival station based on where your route begins, not simply which station name looks more familiar.

## Local tip

The neighborhood is walkable, but distances add up when you include cafe stops and shopping. Check your final stop before deciding which station to use for the return trip.
